newsitem.title: USA: Collagen may spin off Aesthetic unit.
newsitem.headline: Collagen may spin off Aesthetic unit.

text.p: Collagen Corp on Wednesday said that it has formed a new wholly-owned company from its Aesthetic Technologies Group unit and it is considering strategies for the new company which may include a public offering, spin-off or split-off, among other alternatives.
Collagen said it expects to move forward with one of these alternatives in the next four to nine months.

It said Gary Petersmeyer, president and chief executive officer of Collagen, was named president and chief executive officer of Aesthetic. He will remain in his posts at the parent company until until a search for a successor has been completed.
The new subsidiary, Aesthetic Technologies Corp, was created on June 30 and is incorporated in the state of Delaware.
Collagen Corp is a technology-based company that develops, manufactures and markets biomedical devices for the treatment of defective, diseased, traumatized or aging human tissues.
